none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

results.references: - Yang Cai, Argyris Oikonomou, Weiqiang Zheng. [Accelerated Algorithms for Constrained Nonconvex-Nonconcave Min-Max Optimization and Comonotone Inclusion](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.05248v2). 2022 preprint (v2); published at ICML 2024. Complexity: $O(1+LR/\varepsilon)$ exact operator evaluations and monotone-operator resolvent calls, including initialization, for the accelerated splitting method (composite-FEG), with $0\leq\rho L\leq1/4$ and step size $3/(4L)$, obtaining $\|F(x)+\xi\|\leq\varepsilon$ for some $\xi\in A(x)$.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Solve the possibly nonmonotone operator inclusion 0 ∈ F(x)+A(x), where F:E→E is L-Lipschitz, A:E→Set E is monotone, and F+A is globally ρ-cohypomonotone. No objective function or saddle structure is required.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: Exact resolvent queries Jγ(z) for any γ>0, satisfying (z−Jγ(z))/γ ∈ A(Jγ(z)). Each resolvent query counts separately as one oracle call.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CohypomonotoneInclusion.lean: spec.Query and resolvent clauses in spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: execute.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact evaluations of F(x), independent of call index and oracle seed; F is a general operator, not necessarily a gradient. Each evaluation counts as one oracle call.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CohypomonotoneInclusion.lean: spec.Query and first equality in spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: For all u∈(F+A)(x) and v∈(F+A)(y), ⟨u−v,x−y⟩≥−ρ‖u−v‖², with L>0, ρ≥0 and ρL<1. A solution x⋆ satisfies ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R. E is an arbitrary real inner-product space; completeness and finite dimensionality are not assumed. E, L, ρ and x0 are public; R≥0 and ε>0 are hidden parameters used in the execution budget.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CohypomonotoneInclusion.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid and spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The residual requirement holds almost surely under the execution probability measure, within a fixed oracle-call budget.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: The output x must admit a witness ξ∈A(x) with the unsquared inclusion residual ‖F(x)+ξ‖≤ε. The witness need not be returned; no averaging or best-iterate requirement is imposed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: This is a structured nonmonotone inclusion formulation with global cohypomonotonicity and ρL<1, exact split operator/resolvent access, and a witness-based residual guarantee in an arbitrary real inner-product space.
